topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't even wrap my head around this, you know? You told me you were working at this high-end place, and then I run into your old coworker from the gas station. It's like, why? Why would you do that? All these times we talked about your day, I was just hearing a bunch of made-up stories. I thought we were cool, that we could be real with each other. I feel like you’ve been playing some kind of game, and I don’t even know the rules anymore. I need you to be straight with me from now on, okay? Just lay it all out there.
